name: Creamy Coriander Chicken, Bell Pepper & Celery Sauté with Red Lentils

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup red lentils, dried
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken and sauté until cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer chicken to a plate, cover with aluminum foil, and set aside. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
While the chicken is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 green bell peppers
6 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl (reserving a small handful for garnish).
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices to the pot; cook, stirring often, until veggies begin to soften, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and broth to the pot. Reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 7-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Return chicken to the pot, stir to combine, and simmer until heated through, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cream.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 fl oz (¾ cup) heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide lentils and chicken sauté between bowls. Garnish with reserved parsley and enjoy!
